_note: Target bands for the balance loop (tools/tune/check.mjs). Only change them after the user agrees. A metric scores 0 inside its band; outside, it scores weight x relative distance to the nearest edge.
_heroes: Heroes the loop balances. AXIOM is left out on purpose (user, 2026-11-28): do not tune it.

skills._why: Each attack skill's value (damage per energy, single + cluster/3) compared to the median of the other attack skills of the same tier across all heroes. Utility skills (control, mobility, defense) are not scored. Replaced by "fight" (weight 0, kept for reference).

bossTime._why: Seconds to kill each boss with an immortal good bot on Normal (pure damage check, per hero, averaged over the 4 starting elements).

bossTimeSpread._why: Slowest hero / fastest hero boss kill time (S5 + S10). Keeps the four heroes close in damage.

progress._why: Mean progress (stage reached + fraction of boss HP removed) of the good bot on Normal, per hero.

progressSpread._why: Best hero / worst hero progress for the good bot on Normal. Plan: heroes within 15%.

brutal._why: Brutal progress / Normal progress for the good bot, all heroes pooled. Brutal should be 40-60% harder (user, 2026-11-28).

skillGap._why: Good bot progress / novice bot progress on Normal, all heroes pooled. Easy to play, hard to master: practice must pay off. Off for now (weight 0): the good bot is not reliably better than the novice bot yet, so this measures the bot, not the game.

fight._why: Fight bench (tools/tune/fightbench.mjs): each skill in an 8s fight with live enemies; value = damage + HP saved + control seconds x 12, per energy, compared to the median of the same tier across Knight, Ranger and Mage.

merge._why: Merging must pay: tier medians of fight value per energy.

bossFloor._why: Bosses 3-5 (stages 15, 20, 25) must survive at least this long even against the fastest strategy (immortal bot with a real build).

stagger._why: Share of the boss fight the boss spends staggered (immortal bot, both strategies).

strategy._why: No dominant playstyle: boss kill time of the single-skill spam bot / the merge bot.

elite._why: Elites (good bot, Normal): seconds from spawn to death, and share of non-boss damage taken while an elite is within 260px. Confirmed by the user 2026-11-28.
